Safari — Medicare scams target seniors during open enrollment — The Washington Post
washingtonpost.com
During open enrollment, fraudsters pose as Medicare representatives, telling beneficiaries their plan will be cancelled unless they confirm their Medicare number. Others offer free back braces or DNA cancer screening kits, then bill Medicare thousands of dollars.
Experts say beneficiaries should treat their Medicare number like a credit card number.
